title: Unpair broken Equil - Issue
body:
My insulin pump Equil was paired with the AAPS 3.3.1.0 Build: c7e8f62f75-2025.01.08
Pump stopped responding at all and Equil provided replacement.
But I'm unable to unpair pump since there is no connection possibility to establish.
[AndroidAPS._2025-01-08_05-24-11_.26.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18344805/AndroidAPS._2025-01-08_05-24-11_.26.zip)

Any help or advise would be appreciated.
